title: Kindle Android app borrows a useful new feature from Alexa Tablets
summary: Android users can now markup their ebooks as much as they like.
body: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR Amazon has rolled out handwritten notes to the Kindle Android app. The feature allows readers to mark up their ebooks with handwritten notes. Support appears to be exclusive to Android tablets and phones, for now. While it’s not everyone’s cup of tea, some people love to write in the books they read. From tracking details in a story to marking favorite quotes, annotations can be a fun and useful way to interact with a book. Amazon added the option to annotate Kindle ebooks on its recently launched Alexa Tablets . Now the company has further expanded the feature. Kindle ebook readers (via The Verge ) are being greeted by a new pop-up in the Android app. The pop-up is informing users that they can now write directly in their ebooks. If you’re the kind of reader who likes jotting down their thoughts, you’ll be able to choose what pen style, size, and color you want to use. When you write something down, the text flows around your notes.

title: New Oura lawsuit threatens to once again disrupt smart ring market
summary: Another day, another Oura lawsuit against a key industry rival.
body: TL;DR Smart ring maker Oura is suing Ultrahuman again, seeking to have the Ring Pro removed from US shelves over alleged patent infringement. Ultrahuman’s co-founder says the company will respond to the claims and that the Ring Pro remains available in the US. Oura has previously sued Ultrahuman over the Ring Air, which led to its removal from US shelves last year. Oura won a key patent dispute against rival smart ring maker Ultrahuman last year, forcing it to remove the Ring Air from US shelves . Ultrahuman has since released the Ring Pro in the US , featuring a redesigned heart-rate sensor and a two-week battery life. Now, in what can only be described as déjà vu, Oura is suing to pull the Ultrahuman Ring Pro from the US. In a lawsuit filed in a Texas federal court, reports TechCrunch , Oura alleges that the Ring Pro infringes on two of its patents, specifically related to design and internal hardware, The company claims Ultrahuman’s smart ring violates patents D804,471 and 12,769,363, and seeks to ban its sale and recover damages.

Whether you’ve whipped up a calculator, quiz, or elaborate dashboard, you no longer need to copy code or rebuild the experience elsewhere to share it.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak discovery could open the door to a world of mods
summary: An obscure game has provided an unlikely route into Nintendo's latest console.
body: Credit: Pepsipu.com TL;DR A developer has released a software-only Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak that works on the latest firmware. The exploit uses vulnerabilities involving SmileBASIC 4 and has already been demonstrated with Mario Kart World mods. The jailbreak isn’t permanent and doesn’t yet provide full control over the console. Unsurprisingly, Nintendo hasn’t exactly made life easy for anyone hoping to tinker with the Switch 2 beyond its intended limits. But one developer has now made a significant breakthrough, releasing a software-only Switch 2 jailbreak that works even on the console’s latest firmware. Security researcher Sammy Hajhamid, who goes by pepsipu online, announced the achievement on X and explained how it works in a detailed blog post . The exploit, called ns2jb, works on firmware version 23.0.1 without requiring any physical modifications to the console. There are caveats, but the jailbreak may open the door to things like unofficial software and game modifications.

title: 1Password’s new solution mitigates the security risks of AI agent account access
summary: 1Password just made giving your AI agent account access a little safer.
body: Credit: 1Password TL;DR 1Password has created a way for AI agents to use your passwords without actually seeing them. When an agent reaches a login screen, 1Password for Agents will autofill the password or one-time code so the agent can’t see or take possession of your credentials. It will work with a range of AI agents, such as Muse and Grok, with more to come later. You may trust an AI agent to help with your work, but you probably draw the line at letting it access your passwords. While understandable, that choice can also act as an obstacle when an AI agent needs access to an account. 1Password aims to solve the security risks of AI agent account access with its new solution. The digital vault and password manager company has announced 1Password for Agents. This new platform is designed to let AI agents use your passwords without letting the agent actually see or take possession of them. You’ll be able to connect it with Facebook’s Muse and SpaceX Super Intelligence’s Grok bot. More agent connections are expected to be on the way, including Claude Duet, ChatGPT Work and dots, Perplexity, and more.

title: YouTube Music is now available on Garmin’s latest Fenix watches
summary: You can finally take YouTube Music with you on Fenix 9 watches.
body: TL;DR YouTube Music is now available on the Garmin Fenix 9 and Fenix 9 Pro. The wearable app lets subscribers download content for offline listening. YouTube Music has been available on other Garmin wearables since 2024, but the Fenix 9 series is only recently compatible. Garmin’s latest Fenix 9 and Fenix 9 Pro fitness smartwatches launched in August . The watches have a lot to offer, including three different size options, new stamina tracking features, and, in the case of the 9 Pro, a titanium case and OLED display. They hit the market with a strange omission, however: YouTube Music hasn’t been compatible with the Fenix 9 series, despite being available on Garmin’s older watches. title: Google Search just lost a handy research feature, but Gemini still has it
summary: The useful "Export to Docs" feature has vanished in Google Search, but there's a workaround.
body: TL;DR Google Search’s AI Mode no longer offers the direct “Export to Docs” shortcut in its three-dot menu. We’ve confirmed the removal on both desktop and mobile, and reverting to an older version of the Google app didn’t restore it. Gemini and NotebookLM still offer Docs export options, but Google hasn’t explained whether AI Mode’s shortcut will return. Imagine researching a complicated topic with Google Search AI Mode , gathering explanations and useful information, then saving everything to Google Docs for later. Until recently, that last step took just a couple of taps. But Google appears to have quietly removed the shortcut from Search, frustrating users who relied on it to turn their searches into editable documents. Several users have reported that the “Export to Docs” option has disappeared from the three-dot menu in Google Search AI Mode. We’ve confirmed the change on both desktop and mobile, where the menu now shows only one option: “About this response.” Similar complaints have also surfaced on Reddit .

title: The next OnePlus phone has a fan to cool your phone and hands

title: I vibe-coded a Pebble Time 2 app, and I learned some tough lessons
summary: It's not as simple as it looks.
body: If you spend enough time on the internet, you’ll be led to believe coding is now easy for everyone thanks to various AI models. Claude, ChatGPT, and others can turn even a novice into a master programmer, and software engineers should seriously consider a second career as pastry chefs. Unsurprisingly, that’s a gross mischaracterization. Large language models do give people without formal training tools they could’ve never imagined before, but it’s not that simple. So, I decided to find out for myself. I recently wrote about how much I love my Pebble Time 2 , and part of the appeal is PebbleOS. It’s open-source, and people can write their own programs to fit their needs. I decided to lean heavily on nostalgia and see if I could recreate the Microsoft MSN Direct service from the mid-2000s. I wanted my Pebble Time 2 to remind me of my Fossil Abacus, so I enlisted AI to help.

summary: قد يكون الفحص الجيني مهما بعد تشخيص السرطان حتى في عمر متقدم، وفق بحث أعلنته الجمعية الأميركية لأبحاث السرطان الخميس، وجد أن حصره بمن هم دون الخمسين قد يفوت اكتشاف تغيرات وراثية لدى آلاف المرضى.

title: أصابع اليد وسكر الدم.. ما حقيقة التمرين المثير للجدل؟

summary: لماذا يتراجع أداء بطارية السيارة الكهربائية بينما لا تزال أجزاء منها قادرة على العمل؟ الإجابة قد تبدأ من خلية واحدة أضعف من غيرها، تحد من الاستفادة من بقية الخلايا.

title: إفطار يشعرك بالشبع.. ماذا تضيف لوجبتك الصباحية؟
summary: قد يساعد إفطار يحتوي على البروتين والألياف على الشعور بالشبع، لكن تناول الوجبة الصباحية وحده لا يضمن خسارة الوزن. فهناك فرق بين اختيار مكونات تساعد على ضبط الشهية، وافتراض أن الإفطار يؤدي تلقائيا إلى إنقاص الوزن.

title: أمل جديد للمكفوفين.. علاج يعيد بعض قدرات الإبصار
summary: أظهرت تجربة طبية محدودة نتائج واعدة لعلاج نوع من العمى الوراثي، بعدما تمكن عدد من المرضى من استعادة القدرة على تمييز الأجسام وتحديد مواقعها، باستخدام تقنية مبتكرة تستند إلى بحث فاز بجائزة نوبل للطب لعام 2026.

title: عادة يومية بسيطة قد تقرب المسافات بين الزوجين
summary: قد يكون وقت المشي مع شريكك فرصة للكلام والاستماع، وسط يوم مزدحم بالعمل والمسؤوليات. فالنشاط الذي يبدأ بهدف الحركة يمكن أن يوفر وقتا مشتركا، بعيدا عن المهام التي تستهلك معظم حديث الزوجين.

title: بعد إيقاف حقن التخسيس.. كيف تواجه عودة الوزن؟

title: الذكاء الاصطناعي يتوقع الصداع النصفي.. ما سر نسبة 91 بالمئة؟
summary: هل يمكن معرفة احتمال الإصابة بنوبة صداع نصفي قبل حدوثها بيوم؟.. دراسة اختبرت نموذجا للذكاء الاصطناعي تشير إلى إمكانية الاستفادة من سجل الأعراض للتوقع، لكن الرقم الأكثر لفتا للانتباه فيها، 91 بالمئة، يحتاج إلى تفسير.

title: نقص النوم المتكرر.. لماذا لا تكفي راحة نهاية الأسبوع؟
